profiles.name: Arturo Gamboa
profiles.description: Arturo Gamboa was shot by an armed safety volunteer at the June 14, 2025 No Kings protest in Salt Lake City, Utah, after bringing a rifle to the demonstration. A bystander was killed by the volunteer’s gunfire. Police arrested Gamboa on suspicion of murder after he left the scene, although he did not fire his rifle. He remained jailed without formal charges until a judge ordered his release on June 20, 2025. Prosecutors later confirmed that no charges would be filed against him.

profiles.name: Joshua Ames Cartrette
profiles.description: Joshua Ames Cartrette, 46, is an activist from Oregon City, Oregon. On June 14, 2025 — No Kings Day, chosen to coincide with Donald Trump's birthday — he was arrested at a Portland protest against ICE immigration enforcement. He was charged with misdemeanor assault on a federal officer under 18 U.S.C. § 111(a) and held approximately two days in federal custody before release pending proceedings. His case was among dozens arising from intensified federal prosecution of immigration-related demonstrators during the Trump administration's second term.
profiles.finding: Official release and court records match name; anonymous AntifaWatch image not accepted independently.
